Modall | Frontend Developer (React/Next.js) | Uxbridge, ON (Greater Toronto) | On-Site | C$60-80k

We're a 5-person dev agency building AI, Web3, and SaaS products for startups, NFL players, and enterprises.

Stack: TypeScript, React, Next.js, Tailwind, React Native | Node.js, Prisma, PostgreSQL

The work: You'll ship pixel-perfect UIs from Figma designs, make architectural decisions, and see your code go into production for real clients. No legacy maintenance, just greenfield builds.

Strictly on-site (Mon-Fri, 9-5:30pm) because we believe in high-bandwidth collaboration. No remote.

Outside of client work, we also incubate internal SaaS products. Team members can contribute to these projects outside regular hours for equity if interested.

Apply: https://modall.breezy.hr/p/552471e37316-frontend-developer-r...
